CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_membership(_nome text, _nickname text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _uid uuid := auth.uid(); _count int;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autenticado'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, nome, nickname)
  VALUES (_uid, COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(_nome),''), 'Membro'), NULLIF(trim(_nickname),''))
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
  SELECT count(*) INTO _count FROM public.user_roles;
  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, nivel)
  VALUES (_uid, CASE WHEN _count = 0 THEN '01'::public.app_level ELSE 'novato'::public.app_level END)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dev_profile_by_discord_id(p_discord_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, nome text, nickname text, discord_id text, discord_username text, discord_avatar_url text, discord_email text, status text, nivel text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    p.user_id,
    p.nome,
    p.nickname,
    p.discord_id,
    p.discord_username,
    p.discord_avatar_url,
    p.discord_email,
    p.status,
    r.nivel::text
  FROM public.profiles p
  LEFT JOIN public.user_roles r ON r.user_id = p.user_id
  WHERE p.discord_id = p_discord_id
     OR p.discord_username ILIKE p_discord_id
     OR p.discord_username ILIKE (p_discord_id || '%')
     OR p.game_id = p_discord_id
  LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
        WHERE user_id = _user_id AND nivel::text IN ('desenvolvedor', '01', '02', 'lider', 'sub_lider', 'gerente')
      ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
        WHERE user_id = _user_id AND is_developer = true
      );
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_manager(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
      SELECT EXISTS (
        -- 1. Is marked as developer in profiles
        SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
        WHERE user_id = _user_id AND is_developer = true
      ) OR EXISTS (
        -- 2. Core leadership roles
        SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
        WHERE user_id = _user_id AND nivel::text IN ('desenvolvedor', '01', '02', 'gerente')
      ) OR EXISTS (
        -- 3. Custom roles with high rank
        SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
        JOIN public.custom_roles cr ON cr.id = ur.nivel::text
        WHERE ur.user_id = _user_id AND cr.rank >= 50
      ) OR EXISTS (
        -- 4. Granted approve_requests or manage_members in role_permissions
        SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
        JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON (rp.level = ur.nivel::text OR rp.nivel = ur.nivel::text)
        WHERE ur.user_id = _user_id
          AND (
            rp.permissions @> '["approve_requests"]'::jsonb OR
            rp.permissions @> '["manage_members"]'::jsonb
          )
      );
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.review_signup_request(_request_id uuid, _approve boolean, _nivel app_level DEFAULT 'novato'::app_level, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _req public.signup_requests;
  _old_level public.app_level;
  _effective_level public.app_level;
  _d_id text;
  _d_user text;
  _d_avatar text;
  _d_email text;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autenticado';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO _req
  FROM public.signup_requests
  WHERE id = _request_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solicitação não encontrada';
  END IF;

  IF _req.status = 'aprovado'::public.signup_request_status THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Solicitação já aprovada';
  END IF;

  -- Get auth.users Discord info as fallback
  SELECT
    COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'provider_id', raw_user_meta_data->>'sub'),
    COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'user_name', raw_user_meta_data->>'name', raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'),
    COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url', raw_user_meta_data->>'picture'),
    COALESCE(email, raw_user_meta_data->>'email')
  INTO _d_id, _d_user, _d_avatar, _d_email
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = _req.user_id;

  IF _approve THEN
    _effective_level := COALESCE(_nivel, 'novato'::public.app_level);

    SELECT nivel INTO _old_level FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id = _req.user_id;

    -- Insert or Update profile with status = 'ativo' AND full Discord info!
    INSERT INTO public.profiles (
      user_id, nome, nickname, telefone, game_id, status,
      discord_id, discord_username, discord_avatar_url, discord_email, avatar_url
    )
    VALUES (
      _req.user_id, _req.nome, _req.nickname, _req.telefone, _req.game_id, 'ativo',
      COALESCE(_req.discord_id, _d_id),
      COALESCE(_req.discord_username, _d_user),
      COALESCE(_req.discord_avatar_url, _d_avatar),
      COALESCE(_req.discord_email, _d_email),
      COALESCE(_req.discord_avatar_url, _d_avatar)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      nome = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(EXCLUDED.nome), ''), public.profiles.nome),
      nickname = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nickname, public.profiles.nickname),
      telefone = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(EXCLUDED.telefone), ''), public.profiles.telefone),
      game_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(EXCLUDED.game_id), ''), public.profiles.game_id),
      status = 'ativo',
      discord_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_id, public.profiles.discord_id, _d_id),
      discord_username = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_username, public.profiles.discord_username, _d_user),
      discord_avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_avatar_url, public.profiles.discord_avatar_url, _d_avatar),
      discord_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_email, public.profiles.discord_email, _d_email),
      avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatar_url, public.profiles.avatar_url, _d_avatar),
      updated_at = now();

    -- Assign user role level
    INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, nivel)
    VALUES (_req.user_id, _effective_level)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
    SET
      nivel = EXCLUDED.nivel,
      updated_at = now();

    -- Mark request approved
    UPDATE public.signup_requests
    SET
      status = 'aprovado'::public.signup_request_status,
      reviewed_at = now(),
      reviewed_by = _uid,
      review_reason = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = _request_id;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity, entity_id, old_data, new_data)
    VALUES (
      _uid,
      'approve_signup',
      'signup_requests',
      _req.user_id,
      jsonb_build_object('status', _req.status, 'nivel', _old_level),
      jsonb_build_object('status', 'aprovado', 'nivel', _effective_level)
    );
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.signup_requests
    SET
      status = 'rejeitado'::public.signup_request_status,
      reviewed_at = now(),
      reviewed_by = _uid,
      review_reason = NULLIF(trim(_reason), ''),
      updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = _request_id;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity, entity_id, old_data, new_data)
    VALUES (
      _uid,
      'reject_signup',
      'signup_requests',
      _req.user_id,
      jsonb_build_object('status', _req.status),
      jsonb_build_object('status', 'rejeitado', 'motivo', NULLIF(trim(_reason), ''))
    );
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_create_message_reminder(p_message_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid, p_remind_at timestamp with time zone, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());

    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autorizado'; END IF;

      INSERT INTO public.chat_reminders (user_id, message_id, conversation_id, remind_at, note)
      VALUES (v_uid, p_message_id, p_conversation_id, p_remind_at, p_note)
      RETURNING id INTO v_id;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v_id,
        'user_id', v_uid,
        'message_id', p_message_id,
        'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
        'remind_at', p_remind_at,
        'note', p_note,
        'is_completed', false,
        'created_at', now()
      );
    END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_delete_conversation_for_user(p_conversation_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autorizado'; END IF;

      -- Marca participação como apagada
      UPDATE public.chat_participants
      SET deleted_at = now()
      WHERE conversation_id = p_conversation_id AND user_id = v_uid;

      -- Adiciona o usuário em deleted_for_users em todas as mensagens existentes
      UPDATE public.chat_messages
      SET deleted_for_users = array_append(COALESCE(deleted_for_users, '{}'::uuid[]), v_uid)
      WHERE conversation_id = p_conversation_id
      AND NOT (v_uid = ANY(COALESCE(deleted_for_users, '{}'::uuid[])));
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_conversation_messages(p_conversation_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 60, p_before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      WITH raw_msgs AS (
        SELECT
          m.id,
          m.conversation_id,
          m.sender_id,
          m.content,
          m.status,
          m.message_type,
          m.reply_to_id,
          m.attachment_url,
          m.attachment_name,
          m.attachment_type,
          m.attachment_size,
          m.mentions,
          m.is_edited,
          m.is_deleted,
          m.deleted_for_users,
          m.created_at,
          m.updated_at,
          COALESCE(p.nickname, p.nome, 'Membro') as sender_name,
          COALESCE(p.discord_avatar_url, p.avatar_url) as sender_avatar
        FROM public.chat_messages m
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = m.sender_id
        WHERE m.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
          AND (p_before IS NULL OR m.created_at < p_before)
        ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        LIMIT p_limit
      ),
      ordered_msgs AS (
        SELECT * FROM raw_msgs ORDER BY created_at ASC
      ),
      reactions_agg AS (
        SELECT
          r.message_id,
          r.emoji,
          COUNT(*)::int as count,
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'user_id', r.user_id,
              'user_name', COALESCE(p.nickname, p.nome, 'Membro')
            )
          ) as users
        FROM public.chat_message_reactions r
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = r.user_id
        WHERE r.message_id IN (SELECT id FROM raw_msgs)
        GROUP BY r.message_id, r.emoji
      ),
      message_reactions AS (
        SELECT
          message_id,
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'emoji', emoji,
              'count', count,
              'users', users
            )
          ) as reactions_json
        FROM reactions_agg
        GROUP BY message_id
      ),
      replies_info AS (
        SELECT
          rep.id,
          COALESCE(rep_p.nickname, rep_p.nome, 'Membro') as sender_name,
          rep.content,
          rep.message_type,
          rep.attachment_name
        FROM public.chat_messages rep
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles rep_p ON rep_p.user_id = rep.sender_id
        WHERE rep.id IN (SELECT reply_to_id FROM raw_msgs WHERE reply_to_id IS NOT NULL)
      )
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', om.id,
          'conversation_id', om.conversation_id,
          'sender_id', om.sender_id,
          'sender_name', om.sender_name,
          'sender_avatar', om.sender_avatar,
          'content', om.content,
          'status', om.status,
          'message_type', om.message_type,
          'reply_to_id', om.reply_to_id,
          'reply_to_message', CASE
            WHEN om.reply_to_id IS NOT NULL THEN (
              SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                'id', ri.id,
                'sender_name', ri.sender_name,
                'content', ri.content,
                'message_type', ri.message_type,
                'attachment_name', ri.attachment_name
              ) FROM replies_info ri WHERE ri.id = om.reply_to_id
            )
            ELSE NULL
          END,
          'attachment_url', om.attachment_url,
          'attachment_name', om.attachment_name,
          'attachment_type', om.attachment_type,
          'attachment_size', om.attachment_size,
          'mentions', COALESCE(om.mentions, '{}'::uuid[]),
          'reactions', COALESCE(mr.reactions_json, '[]'::jsonb),
          'is_edited', COALESCE(om.is_edited, false),
          'is_deleted', COALESCE(om.is_deleted, false),
          'deleted_for_users', COALESCE(om.deleted_for_users, '{}'::uuid[]),
          'created_at', om.created_at,
          'updated_at', om.updated_at
        ) ORDER BY om.created_at ASC
      ) INTO v_result
      FROM ordered_msgs om
      LEFT JOIN message_reactions mr ON mr.message_id = om.id;

      RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_conversation_messages(p_conversation_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 60, p_before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_result JSONB;
      v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
    BEGIN
      WITH raw_msgs AS (
        SELECT
          m.id,
          m.conversation_id,
          m.sender_id,
          COALESCE(p.nickname, p.nome, 'Membro') as sender_name,
          p.nickname as sender_nickname,
          p.game_id as sender_game_id,
          COALESCE(p.discord_avatar_url, p.avatar_url) as sender_avatar,
          CASE 
            WHEN m.is_deleted_for_everyone THEN '🚫 Mensagem apagada'
            ELSE m.content 
          END as content,
          m.status,
          m.message_type,
          m.reply_to_id,
          m.attachment_url,
          m.attachment_name,
          m.attachment_type,
          m.attachment_size,
          m.mentions,
          COALESCE(m.is_edited, false) as is_edited,
          m.edited_at,
          COALESCE(m.is_deleted_for_everyone, false) as is_deleted,
          COALESCE(m.is_deleted_for_everyone, false) as is_deleted_for_everyone,
          COALESCE(m.is_forwarded, false) as is_forwarded,
          m.forwarded_from_name,
          COALESCE(m.is_pinned, false) as is_pinned,
          m.pinned_at,
          m.pinned_by,
          m.poll_data,
          m.event_data,
          m.thread_parent_id,
          COALESCE(m.thread_reply_count, 0) as thread_reply_count,
          m.expires_at,
          m.deleted_for_users,
          m.created_at,
          m.updated_at,
          (m.sender_id = v_uid) as is_self,
          EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_saved_messages s WHERE s.user_id = v_uid AND s.message_id = m.id) as is_saved
        FROM public.chat_messages m
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = m.sender_id
        WHERE m.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
          AND (p_before IS NULL OR m.created_at < p_before)
          AND (m.thread_parent_id IS NULL) -- apenas mensagens principais, replies ficam dentro da thread
          AND (m.expires_at IS NULL OR m.expires_at > v_now) -- filtra expiradas
          AND (m.deleted_for_users IS NULL OR NOT (v_uid = ANY(m.deleted_for_users)))
        ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
        LIMIT p_limit
      ),
      ordered_msgs AS (
        SELECT * FROM raw_msgs ORDER BY created_at ASC
      ),
      replies AS (
        SELECT
          om.id as message_id,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', orig.id,
            'sender_name', COALESCE(op.nickname, op.nome, 'Membro'),
            'content', CASE WHEN orig.is_deleted_for_everyone THEN '🚫 Mensagem apagada' ELSE orig.content END,
            'message_type', orig.message_type,
            'attachment_name', orig.attachment_name
          ) as reply_to_message
        FROM ordered_msgs om
        INNER JOIN public.chat_messages orig ON orig.id = om.reply_to_id
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles op ON op.user_id = orig.sender_id
      ),
      reactions AS (
        SELECT
          r.message_id,
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', r.id,
              'message_id', r.message_id,
              'user_id', r.user_id,
              'emoji', r.emoji,
              'created_at', r.created_at,
              'user_name', COALESCE(rp.nickname, rp.nome, 'Membro')
            )
          ) as reactions_json
        FROM public.chat_message_reactions r
        INNER JOIN ordered_msgs om ON om.id = r.message_id
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles rp ON rp.user_id = r.user_id
        GROUP BY r.message_id
      )
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', om.id,
          'conversation_id', om.conversation_id,
          'sender_id', om.sender_id,
          'sender_name', om.sender_name,
          'sender_nickname', om.sender_nickname,
          'sender_game_id', om.sender_game_id,
          'sender_avatar', om.sender_avatar,
          'content', om.content,
          'status', om.status,
          'message_type', om.message_type,
          'reply_to_id', om.reply_to_id,
          'reply_to_message', rep.reply_to_message,
          'attachment_url', om.attachment_url,
          'attachment_name', om.attachment_name,
          'attachment_type', om.attachment_type,
          'attachment_size', om.attachment_size,
          'mentions', om.mentions,
          'is_edited', om.is_edited,
          'edited_at', om.edited_at,
          'is_deleted', om.is_deleted,
          'is_deleted_for_everyone', om.is_deleted_for_everyone,
          'is_forwarded', om.is_forwarded,
          'forwarded_from_name', om.forwarded_from_name,
          'is_pinned', om.is_pinned,
          'pinned_at', om.pinned_at,
          'pinned_by', om.pinned_by,
          'poll_data', om.poll_data,
          'event_data', om.event_data,
          'thread_parent_id', om.thread_parent_id,
          'thread_reply_count', om.thread_reply_count,
          'expires_at', om.expires_at,
          'is_saved', om.is_saved,
          'deleted_for_users', om.deleted_for_users,
          'reactions', COALESCE(react.reactions_json, '[]'::jsonb),
          'created_at', om.created_at,
          'updated_at', om.updated_at,
          'is_self', om.is_self
        )
      )
      INTO v_result
      FROM ordered_msgs om
      LEFT JOIN replies rep ON rep.message_id = om.id
      LEFT JOIN reactions react ON react.message_id = om.id;

      RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_saved_messages(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autorizado'; END IF;

      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', s.id,
          'message_id', s.message_id,
          'conversation_id', s.conversation_id,
          'saved_at', s.created_at,
          'content', m.content,
          'message_type', m.message_type,
          'attachment_url', m.attachment_url,
          'attachment_name', m.attachment_name,
          'attachment_type', m.attachment_type,
          'created_at', m.created_at,
          'sender_id', m.sender_id,
          'sender_name', COALESCE(p.nickname, p.nome, 'Membro'),
          'sender_avatar', COALESCE(p.discord_avatar_url, p.avatar_url),
          'conversation_title', COALESCE(c.title, 'Chat'),
          'conversation_type', c.type
        )
      )
      INTO v_result
      FROM public.chat_saved_messages s
      JOIN public.chat_messages m ON m.id = s.message_id
      JOIN public.chat_conversations c ON c.id = s.conversation_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = m.sender_id
      WHERE s.user_id = v_uid
      ORDER BY s.created_at DESC;

      RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_thread_messages(p_parent_message_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      WITH raw_msgs AS (
        SELECT
          m.id,
          m.conversation_id,
          m.sender_id,
          COALESCE(p.nickname, p.nome, 'Membro') as sender_name,
          p.nickname as sender_nickname,
          p.game_id as sender_game_id,
          COALESCE(p.discord_avatar_url, p.avatar_url) as sender_avatar,
          CASE 
            WHEN m.is_deleted_for_everyone THEN '🚫 Mensagem apagada'
            ELSE m.content 
          END as content,
          m.status,
          m.message_type,
          m.reply_to_id,
          m.attachment_url,
          m.attachment_name,
          m.attachment_type,
          m.attachment_size,
          m.mentions,
          COALESCE(m.is_edited, false) as is_edited,
          m.edited_at,
          COALESCE(m.is_deleted_for_everyone, false) as is_deleted,
          COALESCE(m.is_deleted_for_everyone, false) as is_deleted_for_everyone,
          COALESCE(m.is_forwarded, false) as is_forwarded,
          m.forwarded_from_name,
          m.event_data,
          m.thread_parent_id,
          m.created_at,
          m.updated_at,
          (m.sender_id = v_uid) as is_self
        FROM public.chat_messages m
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = m.sender_id
        WHERE m.thread_parent_id = p_parent_message_id
          AND (m.deleted_for_users IS NULL OR NOT (v_uid = ANY(m.deleted_for_users)))
        ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
        LIMIT p_limit
      )
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) INTO v_result FROM raw_msgs r;

      RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_user_conversations(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
        RETURN '[]'::jsonb;
      END IF;

      WITH user_convs AS (
        SELECT
          c.id,
          c.type,
          c.title,
          c.description,
          c.avatar_url,
          c.created_by,
          c.only_admins_can_post,
          COALESCE(my_p.is_archived, false) as is_archived,
          COALESCE(my_p.is_pinned, false) as is_pinned,
          COALESCE(my_p.is_muted, false) as is_muted,
          c.created_at,
          c.updated_at,
          c.last_message,
          COALESCE(c.last_message_at, c.created_at) as last_message_at,
          c.last_message_sender_id,
          my_p.last_read_at,
          CASE
            WHEN c.created_by = v_uid THEN 'admin'
            ELSE COALESCE(my_p.role, 'member')
          END as my_role
        FROM public.chat_conversations c
        INNER JOIN public.chat_participants my_p
          ON my_p.conversation_id = c.id AND my_p.user_id = v_uid
        WHERE my_p.deleted_at IS NULL OR c.last_message_at > my_p.deleted_at
      ),
      unread_counts AS (
        SELECT
          uc.id as conversation_id,
          COUNT(m.id)::int as unread_count
        FROM user_convs uc
        LEFT JOIN public.chat_messages m
          ON m.conversation_id = uc.id
          AND m.created_at > COALESCE(uc.last_read_at, '1970-01-01'::timestamptz)
          AND m.sender_id != v_uid
          AND (m.deleted_for_users IS NULL OR NOT (v_uid = ANY(m.deleted_for_users)))
          AND m.is_deleted_for_everyone IS NOT TRUE
        GROUP BY uc.id
      ),
      conv_participants AS (
        SELECT
          cp.conversation_id,
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', cp.id,
              'conversation_id', cp.conversation_id,
              'user_id', cp.user_id,
              'role', CASE WHEN uc.created_by = cp.user_id THEN 'admin' ELSE COALESCE(cp.role, 'member') END,
              'joined_at', cp.joined_at,
              'last_read_at', cp.last_read_at,
              'is_muted', COALESCE(cp.is_muted, false),
              'is_pinned', COALESCE(cp.is_pinned, false),
              'is_archived', COALESCE(cp.is_archived, false),
              'custom_nickname', cp.custom_nickname,
              'profile', jsonb_build_object(
                'user_id', p.user_id,
                'nome', COALESCE(p.nome, 'Membro'),
                'nickname', p.nickname,
                'telefone', p.telefone,
                'game_id', p.game_id,
                'status', COALESCE(p.status, 'ativo'),
                'nivel', COALESCE(ur.nivel, 'novato'),
                'presence_status', COALESCE(upr.status, 'offline'),
                'online_since', upr.online_since,
                'total_seconds_online', COALESCE(upr.total_seconds_online, 0),
                'discord_id', p.discord_id,
                'discord_username', p.discord_username,
                'discord_avatar_url', COALESCE(p.discord_avatar_url, p.avatar_url),
                'is_developer', COALESCE(p.is_developer, false)
              )
            ) ORDER BY cp.joined_at ASC
          ) as participants_json
        FROM public.chat_participants cp
        INNER JOIN user_convs uc ON uc.id = cp.conversation_id
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = cp.user_id
        LEFT JOIN public.user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = cp.user_id
        LEFT JOIN public.user_presence upr ON upr.user_id = cp.user_id
        WHERE cp.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY cp.conversation_id
      )
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', uc.id,
          'type', uc.type,
          'title', uc.title,
          'description', uc.description,
          'avatar_url', uc.avatar_url,
          'created_by', uc.created_by,
          'only_admins_can_post', uc.only_admins_can_post,
          'is_archived', uc.is_archived,
          'is_pinned', uc.is_pinned,
          'is_muted', uc.is_muted,
          'created_at', uc.created_at,
          'updated_at', uc.updated_at,
          'last_message', uc.last_message,
          'last_message_at', uc.last_message_at,
          'last_message_sender_id', uc.last_message_sender_id,
          'my_role', uc.my_role,
          'unread_count', COALESCE(unr.unread_count, 0),
          'participants', COALESCE(parts.participants_json, '[]'::jsonb),
          'other_participant', (
            SELECT (elem->'profile')
            FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(parts.participants_json, '[]'::jsonb)) elem
            WHERE (elem->>'user_id')::uuid != v_uid
            LIMIT 1
          )
        )
        ORDER BY uc.is_pinned DESC, uc.last_message_at DESC
      )
      INTO v_result
      FROM user_convs uc
      LEFT JOIN unread_counts unr ON unr.conversation_id = uc.id
      LEFT JOIN conv_participants parts ON parts.conversation_id = uc.id;

      RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_user_reminders(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autorizado'; END IF;

      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', r.id,
          'message_id', r.message_id,
          'conversation_id', r.conversation_id,
          'remind_at', r.remind_at,
          'note', r.note,
          'is_completed', r.is_completed,
          'created_at', r.created_at,
          'message_content', m.content,
          'sender_name', COALESCE(p.nickname, p.nome, 'Membro'),
          'conversation_title', COALESCE(c.title, 'Chat')
        )
      )
      INTO v_result
      FROM public.chat_reminders r
      JOIN public.chat_messages m ON m.id = r.message_id
      JOIN public.chat_conversations c ON c.id = r.conversation_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = m.sender_id
      WHERE r.user_id = v_uid AND r.is_completed = false
      ORDER BY r.remind_at ASC;

      RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_send_chat_message(p_conversation_id uuid, p_content text, p_message_type text DEFAULT 'text'::text, p_reply_to_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_attachment_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_attachment_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_attachment_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_attachment_size numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_mentions uuid[] DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[], p_is_forwarded boolean DEFAULT false, p_forwarded_from_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_new_id UUID;
      v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
      v_sender_profile RECORD;
      v_reply_msg JSONB;
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autorizado'; END IF;

      -- Insere a mensagem
      INSERT INTO public.chat_messages (
        conversation_id,
        sender_id,
        content,
        message_type,
        reply_to_id,
        attachment_url,
        attachment_name,
        attachment_type,
        attachment_size,
        mentions,
        is_forwarded,
        forwarded_from_name,
        status,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        p_conversation_id,
        v_uid,
        p_content,
        COALESCE(p_message_type, 'text'),
        p_reply_to_id,
        p_attachment_url,
        p_attachment_name,
        p_attachment_type,
        p_attachment_size,
        p_mentions,
        COALESCE(p_is_forwarded, false),
        p_forwarded_from_name,
        'sent',
        v_now,
        v_now
      ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

      -- Atualiza última mensagem na conversa
      UPDATE public.chat_conversations
      SET last_message = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_content, ''), p_attachment_name, 'Anexo'),
          last_message_at = v_now,
          last_message_sender_id = v_uid,
          updated_at = v_now
      WHERE id = p_conversation_id;

      -- Busca dados do remetente
      SELECT user_id, COALESCE(nickname, nome, 'Membro') as name, nickname, game_id, COALESCE(discord_avatar_url, avatar_url) as avatar
      INTO v_sender_profile
      FROM public.profiles
      WHERE user_id = v_uid;

      -- Busca reply se houver
      IF p_reply_to_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
          'id', orig.id,
          'sender_name', COALESCE(op.nickname, op.nome, 'Membro'),
          'content', CASE WHEN orig.is_deleted_for_everyone THEN '🚫 Mensagem apagada' ELSE orig.content END,
          'message_type', orig.message_type,
          'attachment_name', orig.attachment_name
        ) INTO v_reply_msg
        FROM public.chat_messages orig
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles op ON op.user_id = orig.sender_id
        WHERE orig.id = p_reply_to_id;
      END IF;

      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v_new_id,
        'conversation_id', p_conversation_id,
        'sender_id', v_uid,
        'sender_name', COALESCE(v_sender_profile.name, 'Membro'),
        'sender_nickname', v_sender_profile.nickname,
        'sender_game_id', v_sender_profile.game_id,
        'sender_avatar', v_sender_profile.avatar,
        'content', p_content,
        'status', 'sent',
        'message_type', p_message_type,
        'reply_to_id', p_reply_to_id,
        'reply_to_message', v_reply_msg,
        'attachment_url', p_attachment_url,
        'attachment_name', p_attachment_name,
        'attachment_type', p_attachment_type,
        'attachment_size', p_attachment_size,
        'mentions', p_mentions,
        'is_edited', false,
        'is_deleted', false,
        'is_deleted_for_everyone', false,
        'is_forwarded', COALESCE(p_is_forwarded, false),
        'forwarded_from_name', p_forwarded_from_name,
        'reactions', '[]'::jsonb,
        'created_at', v_now,
        'updated_at', v_now,
        'is_self', true
      ) INTO v_result;

      RETURN v_result;
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_send_thread_reply(p_parent_message_id uuid, p_conversation_id uuid, p_content text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid UUID := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
      v_msg_id UUID;
      v_result JSONB;
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autorizado'; END IF;

      INSERT INTO public.chat_messages (
        conversation_id,
        sender_id,
        content,
        message_type,
        thread_parent_id,
        status
      )
      VALUES (
        p_conversation_id,
        v_uid,
        p_content,
        'text',
        p_parent_message_id,
        'sent'
      )
      RETURNING id INTO v_msg_id;

      -- Incrementa contagem na mensagem pai
      UPDATE public.chat_messages
      SET thread_reply_count = COALESCE(thread_reply_count, 0) + 1, updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = p_parent_message_id;

      -- Atualiza última mensagem na conversa
      UPDATE public.chat_conversations
      SET last_message = p_content, last_message_at = now(), last_message_sender_id = v_uid, updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = p_conversation_id;

      SELECT to_jsonb(m) INTO v_result FROM public.chat_messages m WHERE id = v_msg_id;
      RETURN v_result;
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_custom_role(_id text, _nome text, _descricao text, _rank integer, _module_permissions jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _clean_id text := lower(regexp_replace(trim(_id), '[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_', 'g'));
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autenticado';
  END IF;

  IF NULLIF(trim(_nome), '') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Informe o nome do cargo';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.custom_roles (id, nome, descricao, rank, is_system, module_permissions, updated_at)
  VALUES (
    _clean_id,
    trim(_nome),
    NULLIF(trim(_descricao), ''),
    COALESCE(_rank, 1),
    false,
    COALESCE(_module_permissions, '{}'::jsonb),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    nome = EXCLUDED.nome,
    descricao = EXCLUDED.descricao,
    rank = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.rank, public.custom_roles.rank),
    module_permissions = EXCLUDED.module_permissions,
    updated_at = now();

  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity, entity_id, new_data)
  VALUES (
    _uid,
    'save_custom_role',
    'custom_roles',
    _clean_id,
    jsonb_build_object('nome', _nome, 'rank', _rank)
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_role_permissions(_level text, _permissions jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.role_permissions (level, nivel, permissions, updated_at)
  VALUES (_level, _level, _permissions, now())
  ON CONFLICT (level)
  DO UPDATE SET
    permissions = EXCLUDED.permissions,
    updated_at = now();

  RETURN true;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_signup_request(_nome text, _telefone text, _nickname text DEFAULT NULL::text, _game_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS signup_request_status
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _status public.signup_request_status;
  _d_id text;
  _d_user text;
  _d_avatar text;
  _d_email text;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não autenticado';
  END IF;

  -- Extract Discord metadata directly from auth.users
  SELECT
    COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'provider_id', raw_user_meta_data->>'sub'),
    COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'user_name', raw_user_meta_data->>'name', raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'),
    COALESCE(raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url', raw_user_meta_data->>'picture'),
    COALESCE(email, raw_user_meta_data->>'email')
  INTO _d_id, _d_user, _d_avatar, _d_email
  FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = _uid;

  INSERT INTO public.signup_requests (
    user_id, nome, nickname, telefone, game_id, status, requested_at,
    discord_id, discord_username, discord_avatar_url, discord_email
  )
  VALUES (
    _uid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(_nome), ''), 'Membro'),
    NULLIF(trim(_nickname), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(_telefone), ''), 'N/A'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(_game_id), ''), 'N/A'),
    'pendente'::public.signup_request_status,
    now(),
    _d_id, _d_user, _d_avatar, _d_email
  )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET
    nome = EXCLUDED.nome,
    nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname,
    telefone = EXCLUDED.telefone,
    game_id = EXCLUDED.game_id,
    discord_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_id, public.signup_requests.discord_id),
    discord_username = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_username, public.signup_requests.discord_username),
    discord_avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_avatar_url, public.signup_requests.discord_avatar_url),
    discord_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_email, public.signup_requests.discord_email),
    status = 'pendente'::public.signup_request_status,
    requested_at = now(),
    reviewed_at = NULL,
    reviewed_by = NULL,
    review_reason = NULL,
    updated_at = now();

  -- Also make sure profiles table has discord columns populated for this pending user
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (
    user_id, nome, nickname, telefone, game_id, status,
    discord_id, discord_username, discord_avatar_url, discord_email, avatar_url
  )
  VALUES (
    _uid, _nome, _nickname, _telefone, _game_id, 'pendente',
    _d_id, _d_user, _d_avatar, _d_email, _d_avatar
  )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET
    nome = EXCLUDED.nome,
    nickname = EXCLUDED.nickname,
    telefone = EXCLUDED.telefone,
    game_id = EXCLUDED.game_id,
    discord_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_id, public.profiles.discord_id),
    discord_username = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_username, public.profiles.discord_username),
    discord_avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_avatar_url, public.profiles.discord_avatar_url),
    discord_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discord_email, public.profiles.discord_email),
    avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatar_url, public.profiles.avatar_url),
    updated_at = now();

  SELECT status INTO _status
  FROM public.signup_requests
  WHERE user_id = _uid;

  RETURN _status;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_set_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $function$
